The current Public Provident Fund \(PPF\) interest rate in India is 7.10% per annum. [0]

- Current Rate Period: Valid for the third quarter \(October 1 to December 31, 2026\) of FY 2026\-27, as notified by the [Ministry of Finance](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESTQHrOzAVy-ChFsOYTe1fDJmkgH3iaspwK7T5hQN-4-12ZQQodgA20I57pC1SXqILpFqhDf-d9uLzPuGZvPV9uE9j_SoUjglgp8L5coys).
- Tax Status: Interest earned is completely tax\-free under the Income Tax Act.
- Investment Limits: Minimum deposit of ₹500 and maximum deposit of ₹1,50,000 per financial year.
- Maturity Period: 15 years, which can be extended in blocks of 5 years. [0] [1] [2] [3]

If you would like, I can set up a task to notify you if the Ministry of Finance revises small savings interest rates for the upcoming quarter.
